title: Tor amplitude on an open implies universal tensor exactness of principal localizations
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, let P be a bounded-above cochain complex of finite free A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let U be a quasi-compact open of Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose the derived restriction to U of the termwise associated-sheaf complex of P has Tor amplitude in [a,b], expressed by [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. For every f in A with D(f) contained in U and every A_f-module N, the termwise tensor complex P_f tensor N is exact in every integer degree i<a. Here P_f is the canonical localized complex defined by Mathlib ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor at powers f.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 36.13.6, lower truncation paragraph; Tags 09U8 and 08E9 for restriction and affine tensor computation

proof.text: Fix f with D(f) contained in U, and identify D(f) with Spec(A_f). For any sheaf H on D(f), take G = j_*H under the ordinary sheaf direct image for j:D(f) to U. Its restriction is H, since on opens V contained in D(f) its sections are H(V). Exact restriction preserves vanishing cohomology. The derived tensor/open-restriction comparison of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde] therefore turns the given vanishing for G into vanishing of the derived restriction tensor H. This proves open restriction preserves the given Tor amplitude (the restriction case of Stacks Tag 09U8), without assuming any exactness of j_*. Widen the upper bound to max(a,b), without changing lower-bound vanishing.

Termwise tilde commutes with localization: the restricted complex on Spec(A_f) is represented by the tilde of Q = (ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor (powers f)).mapHomologicalComplex(P). This is the open-immersion specialization of the affine derived pullback computation [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde]. Apply [lem-pc-affine-tor-amplitude-criterion] to Q and interval [a,max(a,b)]. Its derived tensor with every A_f-module N has zero homology in every degree i<a.

Localization is exact and preserves finite free modules, so Q remains bounded above with flat terms. By [lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat], Q is K-flat. Consequently termwise tensor with N computes the derived tensor used in the previous step. Its homology in degree i<a is zero, equivalently it is ExactAt i. The canonical Shrink linear equivalences in the localization functor transport this exactness without changing the module or differential.
